steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const o=g.observatory; const d=o.deckAt; const y0=o.deckTop+0.95; const out=[]; for(let az=0; az<360; az+=15){ let best=-90; for(let r=40; r<7000; r*=1.08){ const x=d.x+Math.sin(az*Math.PI/180)*r, z=d.z-Math.cos(az*Math.PI/180)*r; if(!W.inBounds(x,z)) break; const e=Math.atan2(W.heightAt(x,z)-y0, r)*180/Math.PI; if(e>best) best=e; } out.push(az+':'+best.toFixed(1)); } return 'horizon from the deck '+out.join(' ')})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const w=g.env.weather; w.cloud=w.cloudTarget=0.1; w.rain=w.rainTarget=0; w.timer=99999; g.env.day=3; g.env.setTime(23.8); const p=g.world.place('tundra'); g.player.place(p.x, p.z, 0); g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); __rhf.settle(); return 'tundra night'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const M=g.meteors; const spot=M.pickFall(g.camera.position); if(!spot) return 'no spot'; M.dropStone(spot, 3); const f=g.state.meteorite; const az=Math.atan2(f.x-g.player.pos.x, -(f.z-g.player.pos.z)); g.player.yaw=-az+0.3; g.player.pitch=0.3; const k=M.streaks[0]; k.dur=80; k.t=26; M.flash=1; return 'fireball toward '+(az*180/Math.PI).toFixed(0)+' deg, '+f.kind+' '+f.kg+' kg'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const M=g.meteors; const k=M.streaks[0]; return 'streak active '+k.active+' u '+(k.t/k.dur).toFixed(2)+' alpha '+k.uniforms.uAlpha.value.toFixed(2)+' visible '+k.mesh.visible+' subjects '+g.skySubjects().map(s=>s.id).join(',')})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.gear.camera=true; g.player.tool='camera'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.photo.zoomIndex=0; const e=g.photo.evaluate(); return 'camera on '+(e?e.id+' '+e.stars+' stars':'nothing')})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ g.meteors.shoot(1.6); g.meteors.streaks[i].dur=60; g.meteors.streaks[i].t=20+i*5; } g.player.tool='none'; g.player.pitch=0.6; return 'three shooting stars'})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.player.tool='none'; g.env.setTime(23.3); const S=g.satellites; S.night=-5; S.update(0); S.pass={t0:g.env.time, az0:262, az1:96, azm:182, top:18, dur:70}; S.passT=0; S.update(0.01); S.passT=31; S.update(0.01); const v=S.issDir; g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-v.x,-v.z); g.player.pitch=Math.asin(v.y)+0.05; g.env.update(0, g.camera.position); return 'iss at 23:18 dir '+v.x.toFixed(2)+','+v.y.toFixed(2)+','+v.z.toFixed(2)+' lit '+S.sunlit(v,420).toFixed(2)+' visible '+S.issVisible})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const S=g.satellites; S.passT=33; g.state.gear.camera=true; g.player.tool='camera'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.photo.zoomIndex=3; const e=g.photo.evaluate(); return 'iss visible '+S.issVisible+' | camera on '+(e?e.id+' '+e.stars+' stars':'nothing')+' | iss count '+g.state.sky.iss})()
